# ClockHive - Beautiful Timezone Management Platform

> All-in-one timezone management for remote teams, developers, travelers, and global businesses.

## About ClockHive

ClockHive is a free timezone management platform that helps you compare world times, plan meetings across time zones, convert times, and manage global teams. It supports 126+ countries and 150+ cities with accurate timezone and DST data.

- **Website**: https://clockhive.cc
- **Free to use**: No sign-up required for core features
- **AI-Powered**: Smart scheduler that analyzes 336 time slots across 7 days

## Core Features

| Feature | URL | Description |
|---------|-----|-------------|
| Home | https://clockhive.cc/ | Search countries/cities, view world times at a glance |
| Countries | https://clockhive.cc/countries | Browse all 126+ supported countries with timezone info |
| Time Converter | https://clockhive.cc/converter | Convert times between multiple timezones instantly |
| Compare | https://clockhive.cc/compare | Compare working hours across multiple cities side-by-side |
| Meeting Planner | https://clockhive.cc/meeting-planner | Find overlapping working hours for distributed teams |
| AI Scheduler | https://clockhive.cc/ai-scheduler | AI-powered meeting time finder with smart scoring |
| Scrum Poker | https://clockhive.cc/scrum-poker | Agile planning poker for remote teams |
| Blog | https://clockhive.cc/blog | Tips and guides on timezone management |
| FAQ | https://clockhive.cc/faq | Frequently asked questions |
| Contact | https://clockhive.cc/contact | Get in touch with the ClockHive team |

## How to Use ClockHive

### Quick Time Lookup
1. Go to https://clockhive.cc/
2. Search for any country or city
3. See the current local time instantly

### Compare Timezones
1. Go to https://clockhive.cc/compare
2. Add multiple cities to compare
3. View overlapping working hours

### Plan a Meeting
1. Go to https://clockhive.cc/meeting-planner
2. Add team member locations
3. Use the slider to find the best meeting time
4. Copy the meeting details to share

### Convert Times
1. Go to https://clockhive.cc/converter
2. Enter a source time and timezone
3. See the converted time across all your selected timezones

### Use AI Scheduler
1. Go to https://clockhive.cc/ai-scheduler
2. Add participants and their locations
3. Set date range and meeting duration
4. AI scores and ranks the best time slots

## Technical Details

- **Framework**: Next.js 16 with Server Components
- **Database**: Turso (libSQL) with Prisma ORM
- **Authentication**: NextAuth.js v5
- **AI**: Smart slot scoring algorithm
- **Timezone Data**: IANA timezone database with DST support
